description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of scalar and git cloning operations, defining tests, and comparing their performance.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Performs performance testing on a large repository clone.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that succeeds if commands execute as expected.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Measures performance for a given command.

methods.name: test_compare_perf

methods.name: test_done
